changes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a completely NEW original Breachline high-fantasy card painting for GIANT CHIEFTAIN. Landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG, 3:2, illustration only. Do not reproduce any earlier composition. No text, border, watermark or signature.

Story: a wounded chieftain has become furious instead of retreating. A towering, thickset older female giant, about four and a half metres tall, drives uphill toward an enemy outside the frame to the RIGHT, roaring a rallying cry. The moment is a powerful, grounded uphill step. She has a broad weathered giant face, a heavy jaw, blunt nose and grey hair tied in one heavy braid. Practical short ivory tunic, loose charcoal wool trousers, simple worn leather boots and a short patchwork rust-red cloak. Her clothes and wind-tossed braid show battle and movement. One old cloth wrap on the upper arm is lightly bloodstained; a small brow cut and torn sleeve imply damage. Injury is secondary to rage and determination. NO impaled weapon, no broken shaft, no bloody stick, no wound-pulling action.

Design the entire body anew from coherent anatomy. Full body in a clear side-on three-quarter view, camera level around her waist and far enough away to avoid exaggerated foreshortening. Head, chest and hips all face uphill RIGHT. The nearer leg leads: its thigh joins the near hip, knee bends naturally, and its entire boot is planted on a low stone ledge at the right. The farther leg trails to the left, its toe pushing against lower ground and heel lifted. Exactly two legs, two knees and two boots, separated by readable negative space, both boots pointing in the direction of travel. Show the complete chain from each hip through knee and ankle to its foot. No crossed legs, reversed knees, oversized near shoe or overlapping contradictory footwear. Natural heavy weight over the forward foot.

Both arms are in simple compact running/charging positions rather than reaching out. Her nearer arm is bent with a firm clenched fist beside her waist; the far arm counterswings slightly behind her. Natural closed fists, four curled fingers and ONE thumb each, economical broad shapes, no fan of fingers, no hand near the head, no item held. Exactly two arms. The fists and forward momentum make her intent clear.

Scene: her stride breaks through a low human-built dry-stone breastwork on a dusty upland battlefield. Its ordinary small stone blocks, roughly knee-high to her, help establish her huge scale. A few displaced stones tumble down the slope, her short cloak lashes behind, and drifting smoke and two distant arrows imply battle. NO additional people, soldiers, orcs, bodies or miniature foreground figures. Keep the landscape implied with one long slope, cool storm shadow and an opening of pale blue sky. Chaos comes from wind, dust and motion, not clutter.

Painting: accomplished traditional oil/acrylic fantasy illustration, believable anatomy and materials, loose confident brush shapes of varied size, selective accents on face and planted foot, lost edges in dust. Simplify fingers, teeth, hair and fabric into expressive shapes; do not etch every detail. Broad warm sunlight on the face and ivory tunic against cool slate-blue shadow, restrained rust-red cloth and muted olive-grey ground. Distinct warm/cool colour variation. Clear silhouette and one idea legible at card size. Leave breathing room around the entire figure and feet. This is a serious painted fantasy scene, not glossy 3D, animation, comic or photographic hyperrealism.
